resources.string: Tasks stay on this phone. They are not backed up or shared yet.
Write down one thing. Come back to it later, even without a connection.
Enter a task title before saving.
Text is too long. Character limit: %1$d. Your draft is kept.
Could not save. Your text is still here. Free up storage if needed, then try again.
Could not open the local queue. No data was deleted. Try again.
Could not open the draft for editing. No data was deleted. Try again.
Changing language does not translate your tasks.
Finnish and English speech stays on this device. Review the saved text and edit any mistakes, especially quantities and dates.
Download Parakeet once, about 465 MiB. Installation needs about 1.5 GiB free, plus any existing model. Wi-Fi is recommended. Typing works without it.
Up to 2 minutes. Leaving the app stops recording and keeps the audio for recovery.
Audio is deleted after transcription is saved, or after 7 days. Keep at most 20 recordings and 256 MiB.
An exported file contains your voice. Its destination may be a cloud drive.

Parakeet TDT 0.6b v3 by NVIDIA, CC BY 4.0. ONNX/int8 conversion by sherpa-onnx. Runtime sherpa-onnx 1.13.7, Apache 2.0; ONNX Runtime, MIT. CPU, arm64-v8a, 2 threads. License texts are included with the app.
Microphone access is off. Allow it in Android app settings to record, or type instead.
Not enough space to install the model. Free about 1.5 GiB and retry. Your existing model and typed work are unchanged.
Recording storage is full. Export or delete saved recordings, then retry. You can still type.
Recording was interrupted. Any captured audio is kept below for retry, export or deletion.
Canceled. Any recorded audio is kept below. A canceled model download can be restarted.
No speech was recognized. Retry the saved audio, record again, or type.
The transcript is too long for one task. Audio is kept below. Export it or type shorter tasks.
Local speech is ready. Recording and transcription now work offline.
Task saved in your inbox. Audio was removed.
Text is saved, but audio cleanup failed. Delete the recording below.
Speech could not finish. Your typed work is safe. Retry, or export any saved recording below.
Deleted tasks remain restorable for at least 120 days.
Restore keeps the previous task status and snooze, without a claim.
This task is being permanently removed and can no longer be restored.
The task was deleted. Your text is saved here and can be copied to a new task.
